answer: Each epoch, a verifiable draw sweeps the atlas, the audit map, picking by density: a lone identity faces one falcon audit a year; one in a patch of k, k times that rate. A falcon audit is a one-hour live work session, all of an epoch's audits sharing one fixed hour; fail it and the identity burns, while its $20-staking auditor earns $10 of nectar. A farmer's 1,000 puppets share too few humans, so they form one dense patch: each faces ~1,000 audits a year, 1,000 x 1,000 x $15/hour = $15,000,000 a year, versus one free audit for an honest user; the k-th puppet costs k times the first.
